name: Spicy Peruvian Roast Chicken with Sweet Potatoes & Cilantro-Feta Salsa (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 large and 4 small food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and slice sweet potatoes crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat, transfer to the baking sheet, and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet on the lower rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until sweet potatoes are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice one lime into the reserved bowl. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime, along with oil, sugar, and spices, then stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
garlic
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels, add to the bowl with the spice paste, and turn to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add chicken and cook on one side until golden brown and caramelized, 4-5 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 minute more, then remove from heat (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Place skillet on the upper rack in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lime into a clean medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl, along with feta, oil, sugar, cumin, and salt, then stir to combine the salsa. Divide between the small containers and refrigerate.
instructions.secondary_message:
garlic
1 (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp brown sugar
1 tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide roasted sweet potatoes and chicken between the large storage containers, then allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat sweet potatoes and chicken in the oven or microwave, top with cilantro-feta salsa, and enjoy!
